tenders.label: Tenders
tenders.subject: New tender · €4.2M · 3 years
tenders.body: Hospital logistics services, lot 2. 184 pages of specifications. Deadline 21 Nov.
steps: Read all 184 pages and both annexes
63 mandatory requirements · 61 already covered in past bids
Gaps: ISO 27001 and an on-site team in Madrid
tenders.reply: Go. Estimated score 82/100: you only lose points on the two gaps, and a partner can close both before the deadline. The compliance matrix and a first draft of the technical bid are ready for your bid team.
tenders.done: Go approved · draft sent to bid team

supplyRisk.label: Supply risk
supplyRisk.subject: Shipment delay · part 7741-B
supplyRisk.body: Due to a plant stoppage, deliveries of part 7741-B are delayed by three weeks.
steps: Traced part 7741-B through the SAP production plan
14 production orders and €1.9M of Q4 revenue affected
Found a qualified alternate supplier with stock
supplyRisk.reply: The delay hits 14 orders and €1.9M of Q4 revenue. Moving 60% of the volume to the alternate supplier keeps 12 orders on time for €38,000 extra. The new plan is ready for your COO.
supplyRisk.done: Plan applied in SAP · suppliers notified

marginAudit.label: Margin audit
marginAudit.subject: Purchasing
marginAudit.body: “Check whether our suppliers have billed what the contracts say since January 2025.”
steps: Matched 48,300 invoice lines against contract terms
Found unclaimed rebates and prices above contract
marginAudit.reply: €640,000 is recoverable: €412,000 in volume rebates never claimed and €228,000 billed above contract price, across 37 suppliers. Claim letters with line-by-line evidence are drafted.

platform.title: Agents need engineers on the ground.

pillars.title: Forward-deployed engineers.
pillars.body: A small team works inside your operation, maps how decisions are really made and ships agents into production on your own systems.

phases.title: From the first workflow to an AI-native operation.

deploy.title: Deploy the first workflow.
deploy.body: Start where the money is. The first agent goes live on your real data in weeks, and its value is measured before anyone talks about scale.

scale.title: Scale across functions.
scale.body: Your team co-builds the next workflows with our engineers. What one agent learns, the next one starts with.

run.title: Run it as your own.
run.body: Your team operates the system. Kofen stays on for evaluation, governance and the hardest edge cases.

depth.title: Built for the hardest work in the company.

complexity.label: Complexity
complexity.title: Designed for exceptions
complexity.body: Agents built for approvals, edge cases and imperfect data, not for the demo path.

control.label: Control
control.title: Yours, end to end
control.body: Code, prompts, evaluations and data live in your infrastructure. No lock-in, full audit trail.

compounding.label: Compounding
compounding.title: Every agent improves the next
compounding.body: Context captured in one function carries into the next, so each deployment starts further ahead.

pricing.title: Start with one week. Scale with evidence.
pricing.intro: A fixed-price diagnostic shows where agents pay back, and by how much, before you commit to a deployment.

diagnostic.name: Diagnostic
diagnostic.note: One week on site. Your workflows ranked by return, with a go or no-go for each one. Paid upfront.

deployment.name: Deployment
deployment.note: One workflow in production. Fixed scope and price, agreed before the build starts, paid by milestone.

unusedConditions: A named executive sponsor and a process owner on your side.
Access to production systems and real data from week one.
Only workflows with a projected return of at least 5×.
Fixed scope, fixed price. No discounts, no open-ended hours.
A limited number of engagements at a time, because our engineers work on site.

dataNotReady.question: Our data isn't ready.
dataNotReady.answer: It rarely is. Agents are built to work with the data you have, and the diagnostic shows what needs fixing before you invest.

pilotsStalled.question: Our pilots never reached production.
pilotsStalled.answer: Kofen starts on production systems, with an owner on your side and a measured business case. Without those, we don't start.

noAiTeam.question: We don't have an AI team.
noAiTeam.answer: You don't need one to begin. Your people build alongside our engineers and take over operations as the system matures.

gdprAiAct.question: How do you handle GDPR and the EU AI Act?
gdprAiAct.answer: Data stays in your infrastructure under a data processing agreement. Customer-facing agents disclose that they are AI, and every action is logged and auditable.

paidUpfront.question: Why is the diagnostic paid upfront?
paidUpfront.answer: It keeps both sides committed. The report is yours whether or not you go ahead.

startSmaller.question: Can we start smaller?
startSmaller.answer: The diagnostic is the smallest step. If no workflow clears a 5× return, we will tell you.

company.title: We are building the team that puts AI to work in the real economy.
company.body: Engineers who would rather ship in a warehouse, a hospital or a ministry than in a slide deck. Real systems, real clients, real consequences.
